'''July 2001 Lompoc tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Lompoc, California on 14 July 2001. [[Chris Schweyer]] won it. It is known from Cat Ceder's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2625">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-14-lompoc-or-bust-7-14-01d2625/ lompoc-or-bust-7-14-01], DeckTech (Cat "CatLoneRogue" Ceder, 14 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-14-lompoc-or-bust-7-14-01d2625/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Lompoc, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Schweyer]]
